title: A conditional interim-payment obligation is a distinct stage between platform remedy and worker recovery
source_unit: One adjudicated Fair Work Commission platform-worker case, UDE2025/160 and appeal C2026/7842
geography: Australia; comparative case used to test remedy implementation in the US-centered atlas

reactivation_order.unit: reactivation within seven days ordered before stay

lost_remuneration_quantum.value: ordered in principle; amount to be determined

observations.method: Case-level extraction from the official Fair Work Commission merits decision.
observations.uncertainty: The order was later stayed pending appeal; no final quantum, payment receipt, actual access, continued work, or alternative-work route is observed.
observations.subgroup: One named worker with adjudicated platform deactivation.
observations.counterinterpretation: An adjudicated reactivation order is legal authority, not proof that the account became usable or that lost income was restored.

interim_payment_obligation.unit: AUD per week into nominated bank account

repayment_protection.unit: employer not to seek repayment of interim payments

observations.method: Case-level extraction from the official consent stay order; the obligation is kept separate from receipt.
observations.uncertainty: The order does not establish that any weekly payment arrived, the final quantum, actual account access, or later work.
observations.subgroup: Same named worker case during appeal stay.
observations.counterinterpretation: A conditional payment obligation may protect against some interim loss while leaving access, adequacy, receipt, and durable recovery unresolved.

observations.period: 2026-09-18; targeted public implementation and appeal recheck

denominator.unit: named worker case and official search route

continued_work_or_switching_observed.unit: public later-work or switching records located

observations.method: Targeted official Fair Work Commission search across the merits decision, stay order, and Waheed document-search route; non-observation is not coded as private non-occurrence.
observations.uncertainty: Public search cannot establish private payment, account status, appeal activity, work, or household recovery.
observations.subgroup: Same named worker case after the stay order.
observations.counterinterpretation: The case advances legal implementation beyond an unquantified remedy, but receipt, adequacy, access, durability, trust, and practical exit remain open.

related_sources.claim: Bounded machine recheck preserving merits, stay, interim obligation, receipt, access, appeal, and later-work fields.

boundary: This is one comparative Australian adjudicated case, not a worker prevalence estimate or a US population result. It distinguishes unfairness, reactivation order, conditional interim payment obligation, payment receipt, actual access, final quantum, appeal outcome, continued work, and durable recovery.
